Classification governs use — not popularity
◌ ClawLess is a runtime/sandbox candidate, not an LLM endpoint. Shared-key, bypass, and "unlimited" endpoints are quarantined — never routed to. Free official endpoints are prototype candidates behind a port; their output is a candidate, never truth.

Secret references & red-team status

Refs only — never values
What this plane does. It resolves object-level inference preferences to a governed provider node, records a ModelInvocationReceipt for every call, and quarantines unsafe endpoints. What it does not do: it does not decide truth, promote a candidate, or expose a secret value. The receipt is evidence; Baltor governs truth and Teleon's policy gate governs promotion.
